# Discovery selection 63

`campaign56-serps.json` contains 71 actual indexed results from eight nonempty
Campaign 56 searches, copied read-only from discovery receipts on 21 October 2026.
These titles/descriptions are search metadata, not verified original facts.

`probe-responses.json` contains the six actual GPT-6.1 Sol responses from the
authorized saved-metadata probe, with the exact inputs. Five batches come from
Campaign 56; the final careers batch comes from the previously saved diagnostic
query in reference60 and is **not autonomous campaign discovery**. No new Serper
requests or source-page acquisitions were made for this probe.

The original validator withheld one short title citation (`Bandi`); the subsequent
validator accepts an exact complete title. Independent review also identified
an uncertain contractor-network invitation incorrectly held as a collection:
the final validator preserves its reading path as UNKNOWN. The saved model
response remains unchanged. Most other test responses are explicit synthetic
doubles, used for budgets, replay, Stop and queue behavior, not model accuracy.

No fixture demonstrates a newly qualified opportunity or open paid assignment.
